vllm-project_vllm/vllm/entrypoints/opena.name: convert_tool_responses_to_completions_format
vllm-project_vllm/vllm/entrypoints/opena.description: Convert a flat tool schema:

ref_entities: create a FastAPI endpoint that handles POST /v1/responses to generate AI model responses with streaming SSE support
retrieve a previously created AI response by its ID with optional pagination and streaming via GET /v1/responses/{response_id}
cancel an in-progress AI response by its ID via POST /v1/responses/{response_id}/cancel
attach the OpenAI Responses API router to a FastAPI application instance
convert an async generator of streaming response events into Server-Sent Events format
create a SimpleContext instance to manage conversation state without MCP tool call support
create a ParsableContext instance with tokenizer and parser for handling responses with tool calls
create a HarmonyContext instance to manage streaming conversation with reasoning token tracking
test the call_tool method to invoke python, browser, or container tools in ParsableContext
test the render_for_completion method to generate token IDs for continuation in HarmonyContext
create a conversion from a ResponseInputOutputItem into a Harmony Message for input parsing
build a Harmony message list from request.previous_input_messages filtering system and developer messages
convert a Harmony message into a list of ResponseOutputItems for output parsing
extract in-progress response items from an incomplete StreamableParser state during generation
parse a message from previous_input_messages into Harmony messages supporting chat and harmony formats
create a ResponsesRequest object to configure OpenAI-compatible API requests with sampling and tool parameters
build a ResponsesResponse object from a request, sampling params, and model output for OpenAI-compatible responses
build SamplingParams from a ResponsesRequest with temperature, top_p, top_k, and structured output configuration
build ChatParams from a ResponsesRequest for chat template rendering with continuation and media support
summarize the StreamingResponsesResponse type alias covering all vLLM streaming event types
build streaming SSE event builders for the OpenAI Responses API from streaming state and delta data
create a mutable state dataclass that tracks output index, item id, and content index during streaming
emit SSE events for text content delta streaming with output item and content part added events
emit SSE events for reasoning text delta streaming with reasoning item and reasoning part added events
emit events for tool action turns handling browser, code interpreter, and MCP tool completions
test should_continue_final_message to determine if the last input message is a partial assistant message that should be continued
create a function that builds chat messages from response API input with instructions, conversation history, and new input
build a function that converts response API input items into chat completion messages with tool call support
summarize construct_tool_dicts that converts tool schemas into completions format dictionaries for the chat completion API
test extract_tool_types to extract tool types from a list of tools including MCP server label filtering
